title: From syllable representation via gesture generation to articulation: A spiking neural model
abstract: arXiv:2611.22499v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Speech production requires a transformation from phonological representations into coordinated vocal-tract movements. This paper presents a spiking neural sensorimotor model within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture. Each syllable occurrence has a neural oscillator whose evolving phase coordinates its gestures and initiates the next syllable. Phase-dependent commands recruit separate neural populations for vocalic, oral-constriction, velopharyngeal, and glottal actions (gestures). Neural ramp integrators shape the rise and fall of gesture activation. Together with articulatory targets, these trajectories determine the extent and time course of articulatory movements. Opponent neural populations provide control signals to a geometric articulatory model. translated_title: 从音节表示经由手势生成到发音：一个脉冲神经模型
translated_abstract: 语音产生需要将音系表示转换为协调的声道运动。本文在神经工程框架和语义指针架构内提出了一个脉冲神经感觉运动模型。每个音节的出现都有一个神经振荡器，其演化的相位负责协调该音节的各个手势并启动下一个音节。相位依赖的命令会招募独立的神经群体来执行元音、口腔收缩、腭咽和声门动作（手势）。神经斜坡积分器塑造手势激活的上升和下降过程。这些轨迹与发音目标共同决定了发音运动的幅度和时间进程。对抗性神经群体为几何发音模型提供控制信号。三十个参考录音涵盖了包含八个词汇词、一个词的替代实现形式、一个音节序列以及孤立音节的输入语料库。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于神经工程框架与语义指针架构的脉冲神经感觉运动模型，利用神经振荡器的相位机制将音节音系表示转化为协调的手势命令，并通过神经斜坡积分器生成发音运动轨迹，从而实现从语音表征到声道发音动作的完整神经建模。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a spiking neural sensorimotor model within the Neural Engineering Framework and Semantic Pointer Architecture, which uses neural oscillators' phase mechanisms to transform syllable representations into coordinated gesture commands and employs neural ramp integrators to generate articulatory trajectories, achieving full neural modeling from speech representation to vocal-tract articulation.
